decisions.reason: Its survival through 2024 and close fit with aviation compliance and security operations suggest results are at or above aspiration, so a large firm with some slack would likely retain it.

Although it remained on the market through 2024, travel-health demand is more uncertain and may fall short of rising aspirations, yet its complementarity with the firm's travel-security portfolio makes retention still more likely than withdrawal.

As a close-to-core verification platform that stayed visible in 2024, it likely meets acceptable performance thresholds and supports integrated service delivery, reducing the incentive to redeploy its resources elsewhere.
